title: Latest frame slot: unshown, wake_pending, waker and end are hand-kept together
trigger: Frames pushed with/without an armed waker; end then late pushes.
effect: Stages of the slot (Empty, FrameWaiting, Taken, Ended) and of the waker (Armed, WakePending) are bools/Options; documented and consistent today.
fix: enum FeedStage and enum Waker { Idle, Armed(w), Pending }.

title: MutedSpeechHint: showing, done, tester and was_live describe one hint stage
trigger: Speak while muted in a group call; unmute; dismiss; admin mute.
effect: Stages Listening, Showing, Done are encoded as showing/done bools plus tester Option, with update() clearing them by hand in several branches.
fix: enum HintStage { Idle, Listening{tester,due}, Showing, Done } owned per call_id.

title: PushToTalk held / mute_at / talking are one stage kept in step by hand
trigger: Key down/up/tick/reset.
effect: Stages Idle, Held, Releasing(deadline) spread over two bools and an Option.
fix: enum PttStage { Idle, Held, Releasing{ mute_at } } (talking = not Idle).

title: Controller keeps running, failed_for and state in step by hand
trigger: Any sync/retry sequence.
effect: Three fields describe one stage (Off, Active(key), Failed(key, reason)); state duplicates running/failed_for.
fix: One enum HookStage { Off, Active{key,handle}, Failed{key,err} } with HookState derived from it.

title: RTMP box stage kept in key_shown + confirm beside the session process
trigger: n/a: hidden key / key warning / shown key / revoke confirm are key_shown and confirm kept in step (revoke resets both, warning accept sets both).
effect: n/a
fix: enum RtmpBoxView { KeyHidden, KeyWarning, KeyShown, RevokeConfirm }.

title: RTMP start process keeps `failed: bool` beside `info: Option` and a request list
trigger: Open 'Stream with...', let the URL request fail or revoke the key with the request failing.
effect: RtmpStart { info, failed, requests } is a Fetch with a sticky failed flag the UI clears per frame (rtmp_start_frame_upkeep); RtmpStartUi { key_shown, confirm } is reset by hand in four places. No bug found today.
fix: `RtmpStart::state: Fetch<RtmpInfo>` plus a one-shot error event; the box's reveal/confirm as one `RtmpBoxView { Rows { key_shown }, Confirm(RtmpConfirm) }`.

title: RtmpStart: info Option, failed bool and a request list encode the Stream-with stages
trigger: Open 'Stream with...', fail or revoke the key.
effect: Stages WaitingFirstAnswer, BoxOpen, Revoking and a transient error are derived from info.is_some(), failed and requests; failed is a one-shot flag cleared per frame by the UI.
fix: enum RtmpStage { Fetching{req}, Ready{info, revoke: Option<req>}, } with the error returned as an event, not a flag.

title: Playout primed bool is the Priming/Playing stage
trigger: Underrun then refill.
effect: primed toggles in fill() with the ring state; correct today.
fix: enum PlayoutStage { Priming, Playing }.

title: SwipeMachine holds gesture: Option and releases: Vec plus per-gesture direction_set/reached bools
trigger: Trackpad swipe on a chat row.
effect: Explicit machine, tested; Gesture uses direction_set + orientation + reached bools stepped by hand, and the app keeps a poll: Option<Task> as a 'timer running' flag (ui/chat_swipe_ui.rs:36). No bug found: state lives in OnScreen.chat_list and its task is spawn_screen.
fix: Fold direction_set into Orientation::Undecided{no_direction}/..., and make the poll task part of the machine state.

title: Swipe poll Option<Task> used as a running flag
trigger: Swipe gesture start and end.
effect: poll.is_some() means the timer runs; it is cleared by the task's own last update and sticks if that update fails (screen replaced, so owner is dropped too).
fix: Derive running from the machine state (swiping/animating) and keep the Task only while it is, or hold it in the machine's phase enum.

title: Calls 'Clear all' stage is recent_calls_clearing: bool beside recent_calls_request and recent_calls_error
trigger: Open the Calls tab, press Clear all, confirm; while in flight the button hides via can_clear(len, clearing).
effect: Stage is a bool set after send (connect/calls/history.rs:190) and cleared by hand in session_apply_ok.rs:63 and calls/error.rs:92, not matched to the request id; fetch_call_history can clear the list while clearing is true. No bug found today.
fix: One enum for the recent-calls list: Idle/Loading{request}/Ready/Failed/Clearing{request}; can_clear takes the enum.

title: Birthday suggestion dismissal is an optimistic birthdays_hidden bool reverted by hand
trigger: Dismiss the birthday card: connect/privacy_data.rs:255 sets birthdays_hidden=true after sending; HideContactCloseBirthdays error resets it (session_privacy_data.rs:182); updateContactCloseBirthdays resets it (settings/apply.rs:262).
effect: Works today, but the stage (shown / hiding / hidden) is a bool plus a reset rule in three places, not matched to the dismiss request.
fix: enum BirthdayCard {Shown, Hiding{request}, Hidden} and apply the error only for that request id.

title: CollectibleLookup stage is loading: bool + info: Option + failed: Option kept in step by hand
trigger: Open a collectible box; the answer sets loading=false and info, an error sets loading=false and failed.
effect: Today all three can be set together or none (request lost leaves loading=true so a repeat tap on the same entity returns Ok(None) and never re-sends; request_collectible_info in connect/payments.rs:293 checks open.loading).
fix: Fetch<CollectibleInfo> (idle/loading/ready/failed) with the request id in the loading variant.

title: gif and sound_removed are two bools that must change together
trigger: Video editor 'remove sound' / GIF choice.
effect: sound_removed is only meaningful when gif is set; gif also depends on cover/edits/source set in step.
fix: enum VideoKind { Video, Gif{sound_removed: bool} } and group source+edits in one Option<VideoEdit>.

title: photo_render Option<u64> marks 'rendering' next to path/kind/file_name
trigger: Done in the photo editor on a tray photo.
effect: photo_render, path, photo_jpeg, file_only, kind, file_name are rewritten together by land_attachment_edit; a send is blocked while photo_render is Some.
fix: enum AttachmentFile { Ready(PathBuf), Rendering{render, from: PathBuf} }.

title: PendingSend.held_send and attachments[].extras.photo_render are two fields that must agree
trigger: Press Send while a photo edit renders (held_send set), then the render lands, fails, or the tray changes.
effect: release_idle_hold re-derives 'a render will land' after every update and land_attachment_edit clears the hold by hand on failure; the invariant held_send.is_some() implies renders_an_edit() is kept by calls, not by type. Works today.
fix: enum TraySend { Idle, WaitingForRender{ renders, held: (String, SendOnce) } } so a hold cannot exist without a render.

title: Draft save clock is an Option used as an 'armed' flag
trigger: Typing in the composer.
effect: started_ms None/Some is the armed stage; the caller (connect/composer.rs) must reset it to idle at every Write, chat switch and send.
fix: enum DraftClock { Idle, Armed{first_edit_ms} } owned by the draft target.

title: schedule_repeat_period is only valid beside scheduling = SendAtDate
trigger: Schedule a message with a repeat period, then switch to send-when-online.
effect: Doc says 'ignored unless scheduling is a send date': two fields that must agree.
fix: ComposerScheduling::SendAtDate{date, repeat_period}.

title: Composer document keeps text, span ranges and emoji ranges in step by hand
trigger: Any edit in the composer field.
effect: spans/emoji hold byte ranges into text; writer.rs:104 and :252 defensively drop ranges that an edit left stale or off a char boundary.
fix: Edit the doc only through methods that map ranges (a rope with attached spans) so stale ranges cannot exist.

title: Login review is four fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Review of new-login alert.
effect: review_pending, review_confirmed, review_error and review_outcome together encode Idle/Reviewing/Failed/Done.
fix: enum LoginReviewStage { Idle, Reviewing{confirmed, outstanding}, Failed(String), Done(LoginReview) }.

title: Terms accept is terms_in_flight + terms_error beside terms
trigger: Accept terms of service.
effect: In-flight flag and error line are cleared by hand on the ok and error arms.
fix: enum TermsStage { None, Offered(Terms), Accepting(Terms), Failed(Terms, String) }.

title: New-login review is review_pending counter + review_confirmed + review_error + review_outcome
trigger: Press Yes it is me or No on the new-login banner with several unconfirmed sessions
effect: Stages (idle, reviewing N, failed, done) are spread over four fields; review_confirmed is written by connect/account_hygiene.rs:53 and never read (dead state); busy is review_pending > 0
fix: enum LoginReviewStage { Idle, Reviewing { confirmed, remaining: Vec<RequestId>, error: Option<String> } } with the outcome taken once by the UI.

title: Terms accept is terms + terms_in_flight + terms_error
trigger: Accept the terms of service
effect: in-flight bool next to an error and the terms option; the ok answer (session_apply_ok.rs:232) is not matched to the terms id that was sent
fix: enum TermsStage { None, Pending(Terms), Accepting { id }, Failed { terms, error } }.

title: TwofaFlow is code_sent_to options + notice + refetch flag kept in step with PasswordStateOp answers
trigger: Two-step recovery, reset and login-email flows
effect: recovery_code_sent_to / login_email_code_sent_to / notice are cleared in several places (apply_reset_password_result, apply_password_state_op, apply_password_op_ok, ui clear_twofa_flow, connect/auth.rs); refetch is a take-once flag
fix: enum TwofaFlow { Idle, RecoveryCodeSent{to}, LoginEmailCodeSent{to}, Done(notice) } plus a refetch request token.

title: Call-history clearing is recent_calls_clearing + recent_calls_error + recent_calls_request set by hand
trigger: Clear call history: connect sets recent_calls_clearing=true; ok clears list, error, clearing and request together; the error arm clears clearing separately.
effect: No bug found; three fields must change together on every path.
fix: Fetch<Vec<CallRow>> plus a CallHistoryOp enum { Idle, Clearing } or a single enum CallHistory.

title: Settings lists share a stale + mutating + error triple per list (sessions, websites, account, auto-delete, read date, star subscriptions, gifts, terms)
trigger: Terminate a session, toggle a session, disconnect a website, set account TTL, accept terms, edit a star subscription, toggle/sell a gift. Each sets *_mutating in connect and apply_ok/error clear *_mutating/_error and set *_stale by hand.
effect: No bug today; sessions_mutating is shared by three different operations, so ok of one clears the guard for all.
fix: Each list is Fetch<T> plus an Option<MutationKind> naming the in-flight operation; staleness is Fetch::Stale.

title: Change-number flow is five hand-kept fields (phone, timeout, loading, checking, error)
trigger: Settings, Change number: send code, resend, check code. CheckPhoneNumberCode ok resets all five by hand and takes the send/resend purposes out of the request table.
effect: No bug found today; a missed reset on one path leaves the box loading or shows a stale error.
fix: enum ChangeNumber { Idle, SendingCode, AwaitingCode{phone,timeout}, Checking{phone}, Failed(err) }.

title: folder_invite_done is a bool set by the ok handler and by the UI, reset by two other places
trigger: Join a shared folder by invite link: take_folder_invite_answer then folder_invite_done=true; ui/folder_share also sets and clears it.
effect: No bug found; the stage is a bool beside the dialog's own state.
fix: A FolderInvite enum { Checking, Ready, Joining, Joined, Failed } in the folder-share dialog state.

title: Change-number flow is loading/checking bools plus phone/timeout/error options
trigger: Settings > change phone number.
effect: change_number_loading, change_number_checking, change_number_phone, change_number_timeout, change_number_error are cleared in four different places (apply, error, session_apply_ok) and the check deliberately may overlap a resend.
fix: enum ChangeNumber { Idle, Sending, CodeSent{phone,timeout,resending}, Checking{phone}, Failed{..} }.

title: One password_state_loading bool serves every 2FA operation
trigger: Any two-step verification action (fetch, set, recover, reset, login email).
effect: password_state_loading + password_op_error + password_state are shared by ten ops; the ok, error, passwordState, emailCodeInfo and resetPasswordResult arms each have to clear the flag, and a request refused by the guard is silently dropped (InvalidRequest).
fix: Fetch<PasswordState> plus an Option<PasswordOp> in-flight marker keyed by RequestId.

title: Inline query is a slot enum plus waiting/armed/token side state in the UI
trigger: Typing '@bot query' in the composer.
effect: inline_query slot (Loading/Loaded/Failed) is correct, but 'a newer query waits' lives in chat_ui.inline_query_waiting (bool), inline_query_armed (Option) and composer_ui.inline_query_token, kept in step with the slot by hand.
fix: Make the queued query a variant of the slot (InlineQueryFetch::Loading{queued: Option<String>}).

title: Business page loads: chat_links_requested/connected_bot_requested bools, chat_links_saving counter, business.saving Vec, one shared business.error
trigger: Open Business pages, save several settings, one fails
effect: 'requested' bools are reset on error/ok by hand; every new save does `business.error = None`, wiping another save's error before it was seen
fix: Fetch<T> for links and bot; per-kind Saving/Failed(error) map instead of one error string.

title: Time zones: time_zones Option + time_zones_requested bool; own info: user_full_infos presence + own_info_error + in-flight purpose
trigger: Open Business hours/location offline
effect: Stage derived from a bool plus an Option; reset on send error and TDLib error separately
fix: Fetch<Vec<TimeZone>> and Fetch<UserFullInfo>.

title: CallAudio is a hand-kept machine: source/opening/injected/injected_open/failed_at/error/speaking/read_at
trigger: Any group call with the microphone level tap
effect: Fields must change together (open sets source+clears opening/failed_at/error; close clears opening/read_at but not speaking)
fix: enum Tap { Closed, Opening(Receiver), Open{source, read_at, speaking}, Failed{at, error} }.

title: CallCapture: active Option + failed_at + error kept in step by hand
trigger: Open, lose, and reopen the call microphone
effect: active is None/Opening/Running (DeviceRun) while failed_at and error are separate Options cleared in finish_open and when wanted==None
fix: enum Mic { Off, Active(ActiveCapture), Failed{at, error} }.

title: Screen share spread over chosen/with_audio/active/error here and screen_sharing/screen_share_pending/screen_share_paused in the session
trigger: Pick a source, share, pause by hiding the window, stop
effect: Driver and session each hold part of one share; resets are repeated at four sites (stale, Ended, finish_open Err, wanted none)
fix: enum Share { None, Chosen{source,audio}, Opening, Running{..}, Ended{error} } owned by the driver, session flags derived from it.

title: Call window linger: `ended_at` + `linger_wake` Option are an implicit 'ended, wake scheduled' machine
trigger: sync_call_window derives lingering from CallScreen::ended_at (id, Instant) and uses linger_wake: Option<i32> as a 'wake task already spawned for this call' flag, cleared by the task itself; plus calls.raised_for and calls.window_opening are further hand-kept stages of the same window.
effect: No wrong state found: the wake always clears itself and a switch replaces CallScreen; but a task dropped before it runs (app teardown) would leave the flag set.
fix: One CallWindowPhase enum: Hidden, Showing, Lingering{call_id, until}, ClosedByUser(call_id), with the wake owned by the Lingering variant (a stored Task dropped with it).

title: Call window is window Option + window_opening bool (+ raised_for, window_closed_by_user)
trigger: Press the call bar to open the call window; close it; second call rings.
effect: Closed / Opening / Open is spread over CallUi::window, CallUi::window_opening (set before cx.defer, cleared in the deferred body) and the screen's window_closed_by_user and raised_for. A deferred body that does not run leaves Opening forever; same shape for tick_active (call tick) and linger_wake.
fix: enum CallWindow { Closed, Opening, Open(handle) } and enum Tick { Idle, Running } owned by CallUi.

title: Recent calls list is a hand-made Fetch: recent_calls + offset + error bool + request Option + clearing bool
trigger: Open Recent calls, page, clear all, switch tabs
effect: fetch_call_history resets four fields by hand; recent_calls_clearing is a stage bool cleared only on ok/error
fix: Fetch<Paged<Call>> plus a Clearing(RequestId) variant.

title: Call privacy: privacy_pending counter + privacy_error + optimistic Options
trigger: Open call privacy settings and change a rule while the first fetch is in flight
effect: fetch/set error paths zero privacy_pending while other requests are still in flight (answers then decrement saturating); a failed set clears the optimistic value to None with nothing refetching it
fix: Per-setting Fetch<PrivacyWho> with optimistic Saving{previous,new} variant.

title: 1:1 call media is driven by CallTransport enum plus call_devices_warmed bool, call_devices_listing Option, call_sound_watch Option, camera_on/screen_sharing/muted intent flags
trigger: Place a call, toggle camera and screen share before the transport exists
effect: Intent flags (camera_on, screen_sharing, muted) are stored on the call and replayed at connect; camera/screen share clear each other by hand (set_call_camera:337, set_call_screen_share:379) without telling the engine of the other track
fix: enum LocalVideo { Off, Camera, Screen } on the call.

title: Remove-from-folder chain: folder_remove_queue + folder_specs + folder_specs_stale + in-flight EditChatFolder/GetChatFolder
trigger: Remove a chat from a folder twice in a row, or while an edit is in flight
effect: Queue intent, fetch spec, edit, mark stale is a four-step machine kept by purpose lookups; a chat missing from session.chats is skipped (continue) yet counted as removed
fix: Per-folder enum FolderEdit{Queued(chats), FetchingSpec, Editing(RequestId)}.
